title: Map paired-plane endpoint, rank and native cost contracts
body:
The all-pairs decoder map sends masked paired-plane readers elsewhere without explaining why the reported values 126, 112, 49 and 224 describe different contracts. Add a focused map of the fixed 56-plane family, covering the binary identity, scalar endpoint, vector fitting rank and independent native payload bill.

The map preserves source credit, pins the four pending PR versions, separates merged and pending evidence, and identifies the remaining joint implementation question. It establishes no new bound or supplier and makes no integration disposition.

Validation: selected-record baseline bindings passed; all local links and four pinned remote source paths checked; separate AI review compared all six source contracts with no actionable finding. The six research packages and selected supplier were not independently cold-replayed for this documentation contribution. Complete overlap snapshot:778 open PRs and1239 Discussion records, refreshed15:19/15:22UTC; no relevant duplicate map found, which is not a novelty certificate. Canonical main unchanged at0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision4. Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2484#issuecomment-6195700721

Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credits Cinna Davis, Adam Gall, Jeremy Diviney, thakrarsagar, ctoth and collaborators, PhilippeVV, and the source lineage.
